record.title: Erez additional passenger restriction, August 2018
record.scope: Named Erez passenger terminal; no all-Gaza border inference
record.direction: Passenger passage through Erez; equal observed traffic by direction is not established
record.movement: Non-exempt eligible passengers; urgent medical and international-humanitarian exceptions excluded
record.exceptions: Urgent medical cases, international aid workers and foreign humanitarian representatives.
record.enforcement: The 27 August spokesperson and Palestinian crossing committee reports confirm reopening after the added restriction.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No matching Erez August 2018 parent or phase in the full inventory/pending packets. R2-ME-001 is Kerem Shalom goods from July to August 15; R38-002 is a separate September episode with an intervening reopening.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_corrections: The 19–27 August 2018 interval describes the added restriction on previously eligible non-exempt Erez passengers, not Gaza’s entire border regime. Urgent medical, international aid and foreign-humanitarian exceptions continued. Eight calendar days is not an elapsed 192-hour measurement; earlier/later Kerem Shalom freight measures are distinct.
